title: HPD
description: A Health Product Declaration (HPD Open Standard): the declaration's identity, its content inventory threshold, the highest hazard found in its contents, and its dates.

x-reviera.instructions: Values of this Health Product Declaration itself, from its summary and verification sections, as printed. Dates as YYYY-MM-DD.

standard_version.description: The HPD Open Standard version, printed as 'HPD v2.3' or 'Health Product Declaration v2.3' in the header or footer; quote those words exactly

classification.description: The CSI MasterFormat classification code, for example 09 29 00

threshold_ppm.description: The content inventory threshold, printed as 'PRODUCT THRESHOLD: 100 ppm' or as the threshold level of the reporting format; quote those words exactly

highest_concern.description: The scores listed after 'Contents highest-concern GreenScreen score(s) (BM-1, LT-1, LT-P1)' in the summary, for example 'BM-1, LT-P1' or 'None'; quote the scores as printed

voc_emissions.description: The VOC emissions certification held, if any

valid_until.description: The HPD's own expiry date (not a certificate's)
